method: Official-source-first, claim-specific authority, NO-PROXY, NO-ACCOUNT-TESTING. Package structure and every source/claim/product/rail/conflict were reviewed; decisive current regulator and exchange sources were independently opened.

decisiveChecks.detail: AFSA register confirms active BN KZ Technologies Limited and active AFSA-A-LA-2024-0028 from 2024-09-25.
AFSA licence lists the recorded regulated activities and explicitly states permitted investment types Future and Option; package omitted the latter.
AFSA states regulated P2P is permitted only on AIFC-licensed DATFs and requires KYC/AML plus approved-bank fiat processing.
Current AFSA FAQ states crypto trading is allowed only on appropriately licensed exchanges and separates technical access from legality.
Kazakhstan P2P pages are publicly reachable, but method URLs do not prove active offers, both directions or account eligibility.
The AIFC market-entry article is directly accessible; original search-excerpt limitation is stale.
Snippet-only announcements and older operational guides remain useful research evidence but cannot establish strong current account-level availability.

conflictVerdicts.note: Current AFSA licence explicitly lists permitted investment types Future and Option. The remaining uncertainty is account-level appropriateness/eligibility, not whether the licence mentions derivatives.
Technical reachability, local authorization and resident eligibility are properly separated.
Public referral visibility does not prove Kazakhstan or CBW campaign eligibility.
A Mastercard cash-out rail must not be conflated with Binance Card issuance eligibility.
Snippet-only records may support historical leads but not strong current operational statuses.
Regulator-side limits and exchange operational guides are correctly kept as separate rule layers.

offerEligibilityVerdict.note: Public Binance referral offer visibility is supported. Kazakhstan eligibility and CBW-specific campaign binding remain unconfirmed; no account/referral submission was performed.

overallRecommendation.original: Treat Binance Kazakhstan as licensed and publicly reachable with claim-bound caveats.
overallRecommendation.reviewed: Accept the package as a research record after the required append-only correction layer. Core Kazakhstan entity/licence, public reachability, KZT/P2P framework and offer-boundary conclusions are sound. Do not import or publish until derivative scope, current rail status, P2P method interpretation, snippet-only evidence and disclosure wording are corrected.

requiredCorrections.requirement: Add the current AFSA register statement 'Permitted types of Investments: Future and Option'. Reframe the remaining caveat as account-level appropriateness, KYC/compliance and eligibility, not absence of licence scope.
Remove or explicitly downgrade the phrase 'for all users'. Treat the official snippet as a dated 2025 expansion signal only; it does not establish current universal eligibility.

Keep the official guides as documented operational history, but change current statuses to CURRENT_OPERATIONAL_AVAILABILITY_NOT_INDEPENDENTLY_CONFIRMED unless a live current rail/provider surface is separately verified.
Limit these URLs to payment-method surface evidence. Do not infer active offers, both buy/sell directions or resident eligibility from the method page alone.
The AIFC article is directly accessible at review time. Remove the search-excerpt limitation and align source verification/confidence with direct official-page evidence.

Separate Binance footer wording (commonly Digital Asset Trading Platform and Custody) from the broader activity list in the AFSA register; do not say Binance pages repeat every registered activity unless the cited page does so.
Retain snippet-only records as historical/monitoring leads, but prevent them from establishing strong current operational or account-eligibility status.
Keep numeric limits, referral maxima and conditions explicitly dated/dynamic. No Kazakhstan or CBW campaign eligibility may be inferred without affirmative current evidence.

unresolvedLimitations: No account creation, KYC, product entitlement, deposit, withdrawal, P2P order, referral or transaction test was performed.
Several Binance Kazakhstan announcement pages are available only through official search snippets or generic shells.
Dynamic product, rail, fee, limit and referral conditions require scheduled rechecking.
No owner-approved CryptoBonusWorld Binance campaign URL or code exists in the reviewed inputs.
